lines.text: Rezin king of Aram and Pekah king of Israel marched against Jerusalem but could not overpower it.
The LORD sent Isaiah and his son Shear-jashub to meet Ahaz, and they said Aram and Ephraim planned to make the son of Tabeal king.
The LORD said the head of Aram is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin.
The LORD told Ahaz to ask for a sign, but Ahaz refused, so the Lord Himself gave the sign of Immanuel.
The LORD would whistle to the flies at the Nile and use a razor hired from beyond the Jordan.
